verdict.rationale: Basecamp's pricing page documents reusable project and to-do list templates that carry the same structure, workflows, and setup across projects, so a PM can start a new project from a template. The evidence only shows templates the user creates; it does not show a vendor-supplied library of ready-made templates, and support rests on a single thin pricing-page line. Missing for 10: evidence of vendor-provided pre-built template library, detailed docs on applying a template to start a project, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Create reusable project and to-do list templates with the same structure, workflows, and setup across projects.
